content.text: /ext:medcp How many children under 18 have an asthma diagnosis in our system?
I'll check the clinical database schema first, then query for children under 18 with an asthma diagnosis.
This is an OMOP CDM database. I'll count distinct persons under 18 (at time of diagnosis) with an asthma condition. I'll use the concept hierarchy to capture asthma and all its descendants.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, concept_code, vocabulary_id, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE lower(concept_name) = 'asthma' AND domain_id = 'Condition' AND vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED'

content.text: The standard asthma concept is `317009`. I'll count distinct persons whose age at the asthma condition start date was under 18, using the concept ancestor table to include all asthma subtypes.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS n_children_asthma
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = co.person_id
WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 317009
)
AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM co.condition_start_date) - p.year_of_birth) < 18

content.text: This is SQL Server. I'll use `YEAR()` instead of `EXTRACT`.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS n_children_asthma
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = co.person_id
WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 317009
)
AND (YEAR(co.condition_start_date) - p.year_of_birth) < 18

content.text:
**76,161 children** (under age 18 at time of diagnosis) have an asthma diagnosis in the system.

This counts distinct patients with any asthma condition (SNOMED concept `317009` "Asthma" and all its descendant subtypes, e.g., allergic/exercise-induced asthma) whose age at the condition start date was under 18.

A couple of caveats worth noting:
- Age is computed from `year_of_birth` only, so it's approximate by up to a year at the boundary.
- This uses "age at diagnosis." If you instead want children *currently* under 18 with a lifetime asthma diagnosis, that's a different query — let me know and I'll adjust.
